stored_text.note: Both files are SAMR standards-catalogue entries (openstd.samr.gov.cn and std.samr.gov.cn). They give the Chinese and official English titles, the number, 强制性 (mandatory), 现行 (current), the publication and implementation dates, the competent body and the drafters. The text of the standard is not stored, so only the title and status could be checked, not the summary's technical content.

english_version.publisher: SAMR / Standardization Administration of China (national standards platform, 'National standards in foreign language version')
english_version.note: Both stored pages link to an English-language version of the standard: '英文版本' on openstd, and '英文版标准' on std.samr pointing to the URL above. The English text was not stored or opened, so its status (published or in preparation) and wording are unverified. Classed as an official translation because a public body lists it as a translation of a Chinese national standard. No web search was used.

title.source_quote: 英文标准名称：Cybersecurity technology—Labeling method for content generated by artificial intelligence
title.why: The register title is the official English title; only the spacing around the dash differs. original_title matches '中文标准名称：网络安全技术 人工智能生成合成内容标识方法' on the same page. The official English is narrower than the Chinese: 人工智能生成合成内容 means 'AI-generated and synthesised content', and the English drops 'synthesised'. The register's summary and notes use 'AI-generated and synthetic content', which follows the Chinese.

summary_claims.note: Also implied by the number 'GB 45438-2025' (GB, not GB/T).

summary_claims.claim: ... that sets the technical methods for explicit labels and implicit (metadata) labels on AI-generated and synthetic content.
summary_claims.note: The standard's text is not stored. The terms are consistent with the companion Measures (CN-09, archive/CN-09/2026-10-11/official.html, Art. 3: 人工智能生成合成内容标识包括显式标识和隐式标识), but that file does not describe the standard's content.

summary_claims.claim: It is the technical companion to the AI Content Labeling Measures.
summary_claims.note: Neither CN-08 page mentions the Measures. The Measures (CN-09, Art. 11) refer only generally to mandatory national standards: 服务提供者开展标识活动的，还应当符合相关法律、行政法规、部门规章和强制性国家标准的要求。 They do not name GB 45438-2025.

key_terms.original: 人工智能生成合成内容
key_terms.register_rendering: AI-generated and synthetic content (summary); content generated by artificial intelligence (title)
key_terms.note: The title correctly uses the official English. The summary's 'AI-generated and synthetic content' is closer to the Chinese and is defensible.

issues: The text of GB 45438-2025 is not stored (only catalogue pages), so the summary's description of explicit and implicit labelling methods and the 'companion to the Measures' link could not be checked against the source.
The official English title drops 合成 ('synthesised'); the register follows the official title, which is correct, but readers should know the Chinese title is broader.
note: Title, number, mandatory status, the dates in notes (发布日期 2025-02-28, 实施日期 2025-09-01) and the competent body (中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室) all match the stored pages. Storing the standard's text (SAMR offers an online preview) or the linked English version would allow a full check.
